The '''Sword of Ieldis''' was a [[Sith sword]], presumably created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ieldis]].

==History==
The sword was quarantined by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] sometime before [[3963 BBY]]. Research done by the [[Jedi Covenant]] suggested that the [[Helm of Dathka Graush]], another [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], strengthened the sword.

During the events of the [[Vindication]] operation, [[Haazen]] tried to use it shortly before his death.<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?p=214611&sid=675d66faf162b7bf4ce620896f8336d6#214611|text=KNIGHTS of the OLD REPUBLIC #35 -- Class Dismissed!|nolive=1}}</ref>
